stops.name: South Styrian Wine Route
stops.quote: The South Styrian Wine Route winds its way through the gentle hills of the region and offers breathtaking views of the vineyards.
stops.english: The South Styrian Wine Route winds its way through the gentle hills of the region and offers breathtaking views of the vineyards.

stops.name: Klapotetzweg trail
stops.quote: The Klapotetzweg trail combines nature, culture and enjoyment.
stops.english: The Klapotetzweg trail combines nature, culture and enjoyment.

stops.name: Ehrenhausen an der Weinstraße
stops.quote: Ehrenhausen an der Weinstraße : A pretty wine village that often serves as a starting point for tours along the South Styrian Wine Route.
stops.english: Ehrenhausen an der Weinstraße : A pretty wine village that often serves as a starting point for tours along the South Styrian Wine Route.

stops.name: Leutschach an der Weinstraße
stops.quote: Leutschach an der Weinstraße : A central town along the South Styrian Wine Route.
stops.english: Leutschach an der Weinstraße : A central town along the South Styrian Wine Route.

stops.name: Sulztal an der Weinstraße
stops.quote: Sulztal an der Weinstraße: A smaller village that is particularly appreciated for its quiet charm and proximity to first-class wineries.
stops.english: Sulztal an der Weinstraße: A smaller village that is particularly appreciated for its quiet charm and proximity to first-class wineries.

stops.name: Kitzeck im Sausal
stops.quote: One of the most beautiful viewing points in Southern Styria is located in Kitzeck im Sausal, the highest wine-growing region in Austria at 564 meters.
stops.english: One of the most beautiful viewing points in Southern Styria is located in Kitzeck im Sausal, the highest wine-growing region in Austria at 564 meters.

stops.name: Gamlitz
stops.quote: Gamlitz : One of the best-known wine-growing regions in southern Styria.
stops.english: Gamlitz : One of the best-known wine-growing regions in southern Styria.

stops.name: Straß in Styria
stops.quote: Straß in Styria: Another popular wine-growing village, which is also a good starting point for exploring the region.
stops.english: Straß in Styria: Another popular wine-growing village, which is also a good starting point for exploring the region.
